title: UPSC Civil Services IAS/IFS Pre Result 2026
intro: Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the result for Civil Services / Forest Service IAS / IFS Recruitment 2026 very soon. This recruitment was released for 1013 posts. Candidates can also check all the details on the official Sarkari Result 2026 website. Applications for the UPSC Civil Services IAS/ IFS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 February 2026, to 27 February 2026. The written examination was held on 24 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSC Civil Services IAS/IFS Pre Result 2026 from the link given below.
importantDates: Correction/ Edit Form : 28 February to 03 March 2026
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
